wheel.route: wheel boss -> wheel adapter -> inside the shin -> shin port -> knee loop -> thigh port -> inside the thigh -> hip port -> hip loop -> under the yoke deck -> body cable pass

knee.loop: a loose loop of about 122 mm between the ports, around the knee hub

hip.loop: a loose loop of about 80 mm between the thigh port and the yoke clip

bend_radius.note: conductors loose (not a stiff jacketed cable) through the loops; a jacketed 10 mm cable would need 75-100 mm

lead_length.extension: 470 mm extension (to the driver in the body, with 150 mm spare), joined inside the shin top

hip.route: rear cover connectors -> body wall cable pass

knee.route: rear cover connectors (outboard) -> up the knee plate -> under the yoke deck -> body cable pass
